queries.sql: SELECT current_setting('track_functions') track_functions,count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.funcid IS NOT NULL) stats_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.calls>0) positive_calls FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_functions s ON s.funcid=p.oid WHERE (n.nspname||'.'||p.proname) ~ 'input_governance_(curator|validator)';
